change.new_text:
getb17:
	pushf				; save flags from disk read
	cmp	BuffInHMA, 0		; did we read into scratch buff ?
	jz	not_in_hma		; no
	popf				; restore flags from disk read
	mov	cx, es:[bp].DPB_SECTOR_SIZE
	shr	cx, 1			; convert byte count to word count
	mov	si, bx
	pop	di
	pop	es
	cld
	rep	movsw			; move the contents of scratch buff
	push	es
	pop	ds
	jmp	short buffer_copy_done
not_in_hma:
	popf				; restore flags from disk read
buffer_copy_done:
